description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractModifySignalMapper' which extends 'AbstractCommandSignalMapper'. It specifies supported actions (CREATE, MODIFY, DELETE) for signals related to modifications within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter. The class appears to serve as a base for mapping modification signals in the protocol.

classes.name: AbstractModifySignalMapper
classes.description: An abstract class for mapping modification signals with specific supported actions (CREATE, MODIFY, DELETE) for the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter.

methods.name: getSupportedActions
methods.description: Returns the array of supported actions (CREATE, MODIFY, DELETE) for modification signals.
